clue: While hiding in the woodcutter's cottage with three good fairies, Princess Aurora goes by this name.
reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is Briar Rose! Flora, Fauna and Merryweather raised her for sixteen years without magic. [laughs] And they STILL couldn't bake a cake.

clue: The Mad Hatter and the March Hare celebrate this every day of the year, except for one.
reveal: The correct answer is an unbirthday! [excited] With three hundred and sixty four of them a year, you're probably celebrating one right NOW. A very merry unbirthday to you!

clue: Lady's loving owners are known in the film only as Jim Dear and this.
reveal: The correct answer is Darling! [chuckles] That's what Lady hears them call each other, so that's what she calls them. Adorable logic.

clue: This is the name on the sign of Tiana's dream restaurant when it finally opens at the end of the film.
reveal: The correct answer is Tiana's Palace! [excited] Beignets for EVERYONE. And today you can actually eat there at Disneyland's New Orleans Square.

clue: Governor Ratcliffe's pampered pet pug is named this.
reveal: The correct answer is Percy! [laughs] Bathed, brushed and spoiled, until Meeko the raccoon steals all his treats. Wiggins is the servant, by the way.

clue: Quasimodo's three gargoyle pals are Victor, Hugo and this wisecracking one.
reveal: The correct answer is Laverne! [chuckles] Victor and Hugo together make Victor Hugo, the author of the original novel. Laverne just gets the best lines.

clue: This gentle gorilla adopts baby Tarzan and raises him as her own son.
reveal: The correct answer is Kala! [sighs] And she sings him You'll Be in My Heart, written by Phil Collins. Somebody pass me a tissue.

clue: Hiro, Baymax and the Big Hero 6 team protect this futuristic mash-up city.
reveal: The correct answer is San Fransokyo! [excited] Part San Francisco, part Tokyo, all awesome. Ba-la-la-la-la... fist bump!
